experiments.name: dependent vector chain with reset helper
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 4000 --iters 2500 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --core 0 --init 'li.w $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr0, $r4; li.w $r5, 1; li.w $r6, 1065353216' --asm 'vfsqrt.s $vr0, $vr0; vpickve2gr.w $r4, $vr0, 0; and $r4, $r4, $r5; or $r4, $r4, $r6; vreplgr2vr.w $vr0, $r4'

experiments.name: vadd.b reset-helper baseline
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 4000 --iters 2500 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --core 0 --init 'li.w $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr0, $r4; li.w $r5, 1; li.w $r6, 1065353216' --asm 'vadd.b $vr0, $vr0, $vr0; vpickve2gr.w $r4, $vr0, 0; and $r4, $r4, $r5; or $r4, $r4, $r6; vreplgr2vr.w $vr0, $r4'
experiments.notes: Calibration experiment (not used for the reported latency).

latencies.notes: 7.07 cycles of helper latency are subtracted. Unroll 4000, iters 2500. Raw measurement was 14.90; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.
